links.outcome: Retention of documented clinical reasoning (R-IDEA score) at one month, unassisted, after AI-guided versus no-AI training
links.effect: ChatGPT group declined at one month (median Δ = −0.75) while control improved (Δ = +1.00); adjusted difference 0.48 points favoring control (95% CI 0.16–0.80; p = 0.004).
links.quote: At T1, the pattern reversed: the ChatGPT group showed a significant decline (median Δ = −0.75), whereas the control group improved (Δ = +1.00; p < 0.001; r = 0.96).

unlisted_practices: Guided/structured pedagogical oversight of generative AI in medical education
Active learning-consolidation strategies alongside AI use in training

screen.reason: This is an exploratory randomized controlled trial evaluating the educational impact and retention of guided ChatGPT use on medical students' clinical reasoning during simulated emergency medicine cases.
